insights.text: Three numbers, one truth. Every line opens to its receipts.
The floor you rehearsed. When markets fall, this is the part that doesn’t.
Twelve years of openness. Redeemable as expert time, fee waivers, rate boosts.
If a better rate exists, you hear it from us first — that’s the deal. Drift never goes unwatched.

personality.name: Long-game architect
personality.copy: You build structures and let time do the compounding. Twelve years of evidence says you hold through weather — the rehearsed kind and the real kind.
personality.provenance: Informed by 12 years of decisions and 3 rehearsals

personality.name: Free spirit
personality.copy: Aisha decides quickly and rarely regrets it. Her money moves in bursts — generous, then quiet. Shared pots suit her: the receipts do the remembering.
personality.src: Informed by 186 money moves and 9 answers · shared by consent

personality.name: Goal getter
personality.copy: Leo saves toward one thing at a time and likes to see it grow. He sees his own rows only — nothing of yours.
personality.src: Informed by 42 pocket-money moves · shown with your consent

personality.name: Long game, lived warmly
personality.copy: Elena builds the structure. Aisha keeps it human. Leo learns by doing. Three ways with money that fit together — and a family pot where all three show up.
